warning.titlePre: Land Rover Discovery Sport TD4 Oil Leaks & Coolant System Wear
paragraphs: The Ford Duratorq is a sophisticated 3.0-litre inline-six with an integrated starter-generator and electric auxiliary compressor — a more modern and efficient design than the older Ford Duratorq V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every Ford Duratorq rebuild.

Because the Discovery Sport TD4 uses a completely different engine family from the V8 M178 fitted to the Discovery Sport 63 and GT 63 S, parts and rebuild specifications don't cross over between them.
warning.source: Source: Established Ford Duratorq specialist pattern — timing chain, bearing and gasket wear across integrated-starter-generator inline-six units.
